comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Alpha Mark the Brambleback. Position him on the weak side of the enemy so you can get jump resets quickly. 3* Riftbeasts are generally bait except for frontline.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Brambleback items. Murkwolf can hold items.
Aim to get 7 Riftbeast online latest by Stage 3-5. Use free Riftbeast shops to upgrade only instead of rerolling. Finish Bramble / tank items.
Level to 8 and look for Bramble + Brawler or Rakan. Always play Elder Dragon when you hit. Once stable, go 9 for another 5 cost.

comp_recommendations.title: Tempo Riftbeast

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Only play from early win streak and lots of gold. Because you are aiming for scaling 5 costs, aim to level 9 around end of Stage 4 / beginning of Stage 5. Best Draven quests are dealing damage for gold, but avoid the 10k damage in 1 round because you can get trapped.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Draven items. Ideal opener will be some kind of resource engine like Rengar or Blossom.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 end of Stage 4 and look for the scaling 5 costs like Draven, Maokai, and Ivern.

comp_recommendations.title: Draven Ezreal 9

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: If you have HOJ first, go Executioner > Ravager. If you have AP / Mana / tempo slams, go Ravager > Executioner. Then pick Spellweaver > Rapidfire with the last evolutions. Can play 3rd Executioner/Lux/Ivern as max cap.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively on Kha'zix and move them later. It's okay to have Spark, Shojin, etc on Khazix early for takedowns.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Slow roll on 7 for 3* upgrades on whatever 3 costs you're chasing. In this example, give leftover AP items to Diana.

comp_recommendations.title: Lunarwood Kha'zix

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Mainly strong with Elderwood emblem. Look for Elderwood Lux. 3 Executioner is a big spike so always look to play around it if possible. Can also chase 9 Elderwood if you have Elderwood Lux.

tips.tip: Open with upgraded Elderwood and slam items on LeBlanc or Xayah. LeBlanc can farm copies of units on your board so avoid fielding unwanted units.
Add more Elderwood as you level with Spellweavers. If you start getting AD items, play them on Xayah / Rapidfires.
Level to 8 and look for Ezreal and Soraka with 7 Elderwood. Try not to roll to 0g because we need gold to get to level 9.

comp_recommendations.title: Elderwood Executioners

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Cap the board with a Lux over Morgana for end game. Lunar Lux is best but play whatever Lux you are likely to 2* first. Carry / tank 4 cost units until you get to the end game. Always focus on unit quality over exact board units.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with AP items. Ideal opener will be Blossom featuring Karma / Spellweavers.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 by the beginning of Stage 5 and look for your 5 costs. You want around 70g+ minimum for the rolldown.

comp_recommendations.title: AP Fast 9

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: +1 tier in strength with Artifact or Brawler emblem. Level 7 board is no Gromp. VI 3 is stronger than Krug 3, but harder to hit because of Vi's popularity. Item priority: Master Yi > Tank > Kogmaw > Nidalee. Only take Phoenix Primal buff if ahead. Otherwise, Execute / Healing Primal.

tips.tip: Ideally play around a Master Yi opener that can win streak. Blossom is very powerful to get early econ or item wisps.
Add more Adaptors and frontline as you go. Finish Yi items by end of stage. You can even play 5 Blossom for maximum Wisp greed if you highroll the 4 costs.
Level to 7 and roll for Master Yi 2, Kogmaw 2, and a Juggernaut Tank. Econ up and slow roll for 3*. Add Gromp or a flex unit in at 8.

comp_recommendations.title: Adaptor Reroll

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: +1 tier in strength with Bronze For Life augment. If playing from ahead on winstreak, consider playing 5 Blossom on level 8 with Karma, then rush 9 for the 5 costs -> Alune 2 carry late game.

tips.tip: Look for 3 Blossom early and play for win streak. Karma can hold items for Ahri. Itemize Yorick or any other 2* tank.
Flex in more Spellweavers + frontline as you get them. You can tank all kinds of frontline: Juggernauts, Defenders, or Vanguards.
Level and roll for Ahri, Zyra, and the 4 Spellweavers. Play Cassio or LeBlanc until you find Alune. Can flex in Infernos over Lillia if needed.

comp_recommendations.title: Ahri Zyra

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: This comp requires lots of rods so take item augments early. Blackthorn sacrifice hex scales off gold value: 3* Teemo > 2* AP 4 cost that isn't holding items > 2* Teemo > 2* Veigar. Blackthorn Lux is a very strong win condition worth playing.

tips.tip: Try to angle this comp with early Azir ideally with Blossom opener for better charms. Take rods off carousel whenever possible.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Make sure you have 2* Azir, Rammus 4-1, then slowroll above 50 for 3 stars. Once you finish, level for more Summoner / Executioner.

comp_recommendations.title: Azir Rammus

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Tristana + Ashe + Ivern slots are very flexible. Frontline can also change pending on what emblems you hit. Take Execute or Healing Primal buff. Prioritize Sivir items. Always play Ashe if you hit early.

tips.tip: Play around a strong AD opener prioritizing Sivir items. This comp doesn't keep 1 costs in the final comp so you can slam aggressively.
Comp is very Sword hungry so keep taking them off augments / carousels when possible. Prioritize finishing your 3 carry / 3 tank items.
Level to 8 and roll for Sivir and upgraded frontline. To be stable, you may need to temporarily tank Vi 2 over 1* 4 costs. Once stable, go 9 for 5 costs.

comp_recommendations.title: Primal Flex

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Prioritize 3* Karma + 3 Blossom + LeBlanc early for clone copies. Add 3 Solar after you finish your 3* (Leona / Kayle not necessary).

tips.tip: Slam items for Karma and play for win streak with Blossom in. Tank Yorick / Juggernaut until you find Sejuani 2.
Try to look for an econ/exp wisp every round when rolling. Prioritize Karma 3 > Sejuani 3 > Yorick 3 > Leblanc / Yunara 3. Leona / Kayle not necessary.
Finish your 3* then level for 3 Solar over time. Leftover AP items on LeBlanc. Karma 3 can also hold items too.

comp_recommendations.title: Solar Blossom

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Very BIS dependent. Can play from Coven Cashout. Can also play for Ornn 3 to potentially farm Artifacts. Always play 6 Defender. Duo carry on 8 is any 4 or 5 cost AP carry. Titans on fiddle because we have no other use for bow.

tips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Invokers. Karma is an example shown but you can also play Invokers or Coven lose streak.
If lose streaking with Coven, try to kill some units each fight to preserve HP. If win streaking, push standard winstreak tempo (6 @ 3-2, 7 @ 3-5) and save econ.
Cash out / roll on level 7 for Cassio 2 / Fiddle 2. Then econ up and slow roll above 50g for 3* units. Then level to 8 for a duo carry.

comp_recommendations.title: Defender Cassio

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Use 5 Riftbeast shops to finish your 3* because you want to rush 7 Riftbeast on Level 7 ASAP. You can carry ALL of the riftbeast carries besides Mama Beak if you have items. Krug 3 is the best tank but you can also tank Sentinel 2 > Scuttle Crab 3. Alpha Mark Cinderling early > Crab late.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Pebbles items. Alpha Mark Crab or Gromp.
Save up econ and try to go level 7  for 7 riftbeast on 3-5, if you're poor wait until 4-1.
Once you have your 3*, level to 8 and field 7 Riftbeast. If you can get to 9, you can ditch 1* Ravagers for Elder Dragon.

comp_recommendations.title: Riftbeast Reroll

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Play with lots of copies of Ornn and Veigar, we need to hit fast to start scaling. Sacrifice Lifebloom plant to Blackthorn early. Late game you can sacrifice Leblanc 3 for big stats -> move her items to another spellweaver. After you hit rush 9 for Kobuko + Gnar. After you cash out first Ornn artifact, move items to Alistar.

tips.tip: Only play around this opener with early upgrades so Veigar can snowball and gain stacks. Prioritize Veigar items.
If you are close to Veigar and Ornn 3 (7+ copies), consider rolling until you hit 3*. If far (3-4 copies), slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Once you finish Ornn 3 and Veigar 3, you can slowroll on 6 for Leblanc + Alistar 3, if you are too far push levels..

comp_recommendations.title: Elderwood Veigar

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Position Nidalee on weak side to get a quick kill then jump backline. Amumu or Sentinel 2 can be your main tank (you're often contested so prioritize whichever gets upgraded). Kogmaw Provides Free Shred + Sunder.

tips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

comp_recommendations.title: Aphelios Nidalee

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Can also tank Sejuani 3. Tank whoever you can hit first. Can also play 4 Vanguard version with Elise. Sivir takes leftover utility / AD items (red buff highly impractical so oftentimes you play Morello). Take Turtle Primal buff. +1 or 2 tiers with radiant items (especially radiant Guinsoo).

tips.tip: Slam Rageblade and bow items on Caitlyn for a winstreak. BIS Caitlyn is often hard to get so you can also slam items like Gunblade or Giant Slayer.
Level to 6 and roll for 4 Juggernaut + 2 Hunter. Ideally upgrade Caitlyn 2 and 2 cost Juggernaut then econ up -> slow roll above 50g for 3* units.
Finish your 3* ideally by mid Stage 4. Level for more Hunters. Take Turtle Primal unless you are super high rolling and can take items.

comp_recommendations.title: Caitlyn Hunters

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Akali can be AD or AP (Flex IE/JG) Itemize Tank + 3star melee first -> 2nd melee -> Varus items. Only go for Kayle and Sej 3 with lots of money. Can  Swap out Ornn for Yorick/Rakan.

tips.tip: Look to play with lots of early copies of 1 cost + good reroll augment.
Roll to 30 on 3-1 level 4 for extra 1 cost copies. Then slow roll on 5 until you have 5 3 stars for solar bonus.
Make sure you keep your econ high because you need to be level 7 to fit solar on this board. Try to be Level to 7 somewhere on stage 4.

comp_recommendations.title: Solar Melee

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Turtle Primal buff. Composition is flexible as long as you get to the upgraded Juggernaut frontline. Best with Juggernaut emblem on Kennen. Prio Zyra Items > secondary carries. Sivir + Ashe is strong, but AP Nidalee or 5 costs like Ivern/Lux/Draven are also good.

tips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Blossom. Slam generic AP items and Tank items for a win streak.
Ideally start holding more juggernauts to pair with the Yorick blossom opener, consider moving karma items to LB or Cassio 2.
Level and roll for 6 Juggernauts + Zyra and a duo-carry. You can push 9 when you hit Zyra 2. Tank Vi 2 over Amumu 1. End game move items to Maokai.

comp_recommendations.title: Zyra Juggernaut

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Best with winstreak opener around Leblanc or Teemo with Brawler frontline. Teemo likes crit items but slam any strong AP items to get the streak going. Morgana holds utility items late game.

tips.tip: Open with a win streak Teemo start and itemize him ASAP. The more Teemo casts, the more likely you can collect value off his mushrooms.
Level to 6 and roll for your 2* upgrades to stabilize and win streak Stage 3. Econ up and slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Finish Teemo 3* and your tank then push levels for more Invokers. If you get more damage items late game Morgana can hold the utility.

comp_recommendations.title: Teemowood

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Roll on level 5 for 3* 1 costs, then level up to roll on 6 for 3*. Kayle has built in 20% Shred at 2*. When in doubt, add more tank and stall for Eclipse to kill units.

tips.tip: Ideally open with Kayle and upgraded frontline. After Rageblade, prioritize tank items. Econ up as much as possible. Don't spend gold on leveling.
Bench priority: Kayle 3 > Sejuani 3 > Leona 3 > Shen 3 / Varus 3. Once you finish Kayle 3, begin pushing levels for Lunar units.
Finish your 3* and level for Lunar units to get Eclipse in. Lunar Lux or Solar Lux are both good.

comp_recommendations.title: Eclipse Kayle

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Core is Malphite + Azir + 2 Flora Fatalis for healing. Play Ezreal or Zyra depending on items, it's not worth to play both usually compared to more frontline. If you hit blackthorn +1 or Blackthorn lux, drop the Kennen slot on 8 for Lux/Veigar, place blackthorn emblem on Zyra/Ezreal and then sacrifice Soraka instead of Fiddlesticks, and move her items to Azir 2.

tips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Blossom. Slam generic AP items and Malphite items for a win streak.
Add in useful 3 costs like Fiddlesticks, Cassio, Azir then flex around their traits. General rule: put items on upgraded units.
Level and roll for Malphite. You will often have to itemize and work with whoever you hit so don't overly tunnel on your roll down.

comp_recommendations.title: Malphite AP Flex

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Alpha Mark Mama Beak. Tank is flexible but ideally its Hecarim 3 > Krug 3 > Alistar 3. Radiant Rageblade is true BIS Mama Beak.

tips.tip: Play strongest board around upgraded Rapidfire and Elderwood. Can also play Inferno to get upgraded shop slots.
Focus on econ and finishing your items. If rich, you can level at 3-5 and roll for upgrades for the rest of the stage. Otherwise, go to 7 at 4-1.
Roll until you upgrade Mama Beak 2 and your main tank. Then econ up and slow roll for 3*. Add 3 summoner or 5 cost on 8.

comp_recommendations.title: Mamawood

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Only play when you have Fae emblem. Stacking 4 Fae ASAP is important so you can get a gold engine. Can also tank Vi primary if you can't find Rammus. Execute Primal > Item Primal unless very far ahead / win streaking.

tips.tip: Play for win streak with upgraded Rageblade holder. Start stacking Fae since getting to 7 ASAP is crucial for success.
Itemize and play Tristana as soon as you find her. Sprykin is more important than Hunter. If you spike very early Primal from ahead, you can consider items.
Level to 7 and roll above 50g for 3* Tristana and Rammus. Use your 4 Fae cash outs to push levels. Give Sivir leftover AD items.

comp_recommendations.title: Fae Tristana

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Consider this as a flex option for a Sivir board if you were playing around Juggernauts in the midgame already. If you get Juggernaut emblem, you can play 6 Juggernauts. Can also play other 5 cost AD carries like Dragon and Draven. Take turtle primal buff.

tips.tip: Open with a strong AD opener, preferably around Yunara. Slam generic AD items and Tank items for a win streak.
Level up for more juggernauts and executioners to pair with our blossom opener.
Level and roll for 6 juggernauts +Sivir. Once stable, go 9 and look for Ashe and transition your board to 5 costs.

comp_recommendations.title: Ashe Juggernauts

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Aim to play a 3* unit in the Blackthorn center hex for max stats, preferably Krug 3. Leftover AD items on Murkwolf. Can also tank Rek'sai 3 if you can't find Malphite 2.

tips.tip: If you don't have Shojin, consider lose streak to guarantee it on carousel. If you have Shojin + good component, play for win streak instead.
Level to 6 and roll for Warwick 2 with 4 Blackthorn + 2 Ravager. Econ up and slow roll for 3*. You can also play 4 Ravager temporarily if needed.
Finish Warwick 3 and push levels. If you don't have Murkwolf 3, look for Brambleback as your duo carry.

comp_recommendations.title: Warwick Ravager

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: 3* Priority: Xayah 3 / Rakan 3 > Solar 3. Rakan wants mana items to grant Xayah Attack Speed. The board can cap with either Solar Lux or Lunar / Eclipse. Give leftover tank items to Lillia 2 or Sejuani 3.

tips.tip: Only play around this opener with early upgrades or strong scaling combat augment. Begin gathering Fae stacks.
Slow roll above 50g for 3* until you hit at least Xayah 3 and Rakan 3. Once you hit all your 1 cost 3*, roll on 6 for the Solar units.
Finish your 3* and get in 4 Fae / 3 Solar. The most common end game is to play around Lunar and look for Eclipse. Itemized Solar Lux is also a strong win condition.

comp_recommendations.title: Embiggen Xayah

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Can play from Coven Cashout. Aim for 250 + essence for chance at Morgana 2 + item cashout. Void staff still okay with Kog since he doesn't hit backline.

tips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Invokers. Teemo is an example shown but you can also play Pebbles, Spellweavers, or Coven.
If lose streaking with Coven, try to kill some units each fight to preserve HP. If win streaking, push standard winstreak tempo (6 @ 3-2, 7 @ 3-5) and save econ.
Cash out / roll down on level 8 for Morgana 2, Sentinel, and 4 Invoker. If you don't have Bramble items, flex in another AP carry like Ahri / Nidalee.

comp_recommendations.title: Invoker Morgana

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Comp to play with AD items and an elderwood emblem. If you hit elderwood lux with emblem you can drop Lillia for 9 Elderwood.

tips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll for Aphelios and Ezreal, you should be stable with 7 elderwood and one of these 2 starred. Go 9 when stable for Gnar+Lux.

comp_recommendations.title: Aphelios Elderwood

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Frontline is very flexible: Lillia + Amumu + Sentinel are your flex options. Best with Lunar emblem so you can avoid the Alune lottery. When in doubt, add frontline to stall for Eclipse. Lux caps the board.

tips.tip: Play any tempo opener that can lead to Aphelios. Standard board is AD + upgraded frontline. Take the spatula off carousel for Lunar if possible.
Hold copies of Solar on your bench. If you upgrade them, play the Solar units as frontline. Kayle is quite weak so don't carry unless necessary.
Level to 8 and look for any frontline that can stall for Eclipse. Lillia 2 is the easiest to hit, but you can also tank Amumu, Sentinel, etc.

comp_recommendations.title: Solar Eclipse

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Only play when you have emblem for Rengar. Stacking 4 Fae ASAP is important so you can get a gold engine. Can also tank Lillia primary if you can't find Rammus. Can flex in Primal as well if you have emblem.

tips.tip: Play for win streak with Rengar and the emblem. Position him same side as enemy carries to get backline snipes.
Keep snowballing with Rengar. Take an item augment if you aren't on track to get 3 items by end of Stage. Rengar only performs as well as your best tank so prioritize frontline too.
Level to 7 and roll above 50g for 3* Rengar and 3* Rammus. Use your 4 Fae cash outs to push levels. Tristana takes leftover items.

comp_recommendations.title: Emblem Rengar

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Only play with Inferno emblem. Ideally needs Inferno Lux to be super strong but can top 4 without Lux / only Inferno Emblem Ashe. Can also play more frontline instead of 7 inferno or Hunter (Taric/4 Juggernaut).

tips.tip: Open with a strong AD opener, preferably around Yunara. Slam generic AD items and Tank items for a win streak. You can also play around Varus/Akali 2 with AD items.
Level and add more Juggernauts and Executioners. Make sure to hold Inferno units along the way. Can also play 3 Inferno for shop high rolls.
Roll on 8 for 5 inferno Sivir + Vi + Lillia + Hunter (can play Tristana before Ashe). When you find Ashe make sure to give her inferno emblem + shojin.

comp_recommendations.title: Inferno Fast 9

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Play when you have lots of copies of Yunara with Blackthorn emblem. Prioritize Yunara > Tank > Warwick items. Murkwolf can also hold items temporarily until you get Yunara online. End game put Last Whisper on Ezreal and give Yunara a 3rd true damage item.

tips.tip: Slam items for Yunara and play for win streak with Blossom in. Tank Yorick / Juggernaut until you find Alistar.
Level at 3-2 and roll for 2* upgrades then econ up. Skip Azir 2 because he's too expensive. Buy a charm every round if possible and win streak.
Finish your 3* units then push levels. Look for 3 Executioner for Yunara. Kennen caps your board. Blackthorn Lux is a high roll top end finisher.

comp_recommendations.title: Moo-nara

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Play with Dark Ritual augment to convert cash out -> AP. Ideally ply for a 250+ cashout for AP first, then take 40s if you need for more stacking. 2x Morgana 2* with items on both is the best way to cap your board.

tips.tip: Ideally open with Coven and start gathering Essence. It is actually better to win early than lose for stacks so don't overly force lose streak.
Level to 6 and roll for a Elise 2, Covens, and Vanguards. Give Cassio or Diana leftover AP. Cash out Coven and convert to AP with at least 2-3 lives (25-30 hp).
Finish Elise 3 / Cassio 3 then level for more Vanguards or Lunar. Play 2 Morganas with items if you have extra.

comp_recommendations.title: Coven Elise

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Ideally, Khazix gains Ravager > Executioner > Rapidfire > Spellweaver with takedowns.

tips.tip: Items are crucial for this composition so focus on Edge of Night first. Play any upgraded frontline tank to stall for Khazix + Rengar.
Keep adding more frontline. Rengar and Khazix will only be effective as your best tank. Item augments are huge to keep your momentum.
Level to 7 and roll for the 2* upgrades. Then econ up and slow roll above 50g for 3* units. Once you finish 3* tank + Khazix 3 / Rengar 3, add 5 costs.

comp_recommendations.title: Unrivaled Reroll

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Roll on 3-1 to try and finish a 3* 1 cost for bench space -> Slow roll above 50g on level 5. Ornn Artifact print is very strong but only scales quickly once you get him to 3*. Kayle has built in 20% Shred at 2*.

tips.tip: Ideally open with Kayle and upgraded Ornn. After Rageblade, prioritize tank items on Ornn so he can begin reliably stacking Artifact scaling.
Bench priority: Kayle 3 > Ornn 3 > Xayah / Leona > Sejuani > Rakan. Once you finish 1 costs, move up to level 6 for 2 costs.
Finish your 3* and level for Elderwood. Cap with any 5 costs like Lux, Ivern, Taric, etc.

comp_recommendations.title: Solar Kayle

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Very strong with Dawncore and Ludens as well. Sacrifice a 3* unit for maximum Blackthorn stats.

tips.tip: Only play around this opener with early upgrades so Veigar can snowball and gain stacks. Prioritize Veigar items.
If you are close to Veigar 3 (7+ copies), consider rolling until you hit 3*. If far (3-4 copies), slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Once you finish your 3*, push levels for more Spyrkin, Blackthorn, or Brawlers.

comp_recommendations.title: Sprykin Veigar

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Prioritize Ashe items > Tank items > leftover duo carry items (ideally Elder Dragon). Comp is very expensive so make sure you take good econ augments.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play around 3 Blossom for a win streak. This is a comp you can only play from far ahead with lots of HP and resources.
Continue your win streak. Pick an econ augment if you have not already. Otherwise, take item augments and push levels.
If you have 80+ HP, you can consider losing Stage 4 and focus purely on economy. Aim to Fast 9 by end of Stage 4 / 5-1 and transition your board.

comp_recommendations.title: Ashe Fast 9

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Alpha Mark the Elder Dragon. Your duo carry with Elder Dragon is ideally Draven but its highly flexible. Can replace for Lux, Alune, Soraka for AP options.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Riftbeast items. Ideal opener will be Riftbeasts featuring Cinderling / Gromp / Mama Beak carry.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 by the beginning of Stage 5 and look for your 5 costs. You want around 70g+ minimum for the rolldown.

comp_recommendations.title: Draven Dragon 9

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Best with Sprykin emblem and lots of copies of Teemo early. Sacrifice a 3* unit (ideally Kobuko) to give Rek'Sai big stats. Can also tank Rammus 3 if very rich / high rolling. Kog'maw provides free Shred / Sunder.

tips.tip: Open with a win streak Teemo start and itemize him ASAP. The more Teemo casts, the more likely you can collect value off his mushrooms.
Level to 6 and roll for your 2* upgrades to stabilize and win streak Stage 3. Econ up and slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Finish Teemo 3* and your tank then push levels for more Sprykins. Cap the board with Gnar or another 5 cost.

comp_recommendations.title: Sprykin Teemo

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Alpha Mark the Elder Dragon. Strong with any augment that gives you +1 team size so you can fit in another carry.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Riftbeast items. Ideal opener will be Riftbeasts featuring Cinderling / Gromp / Mama Beak carry.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 by the beginning of Stage 5 and look for your 5 costs. You want around 70g+ minimum for the rolldown.

comp_recommendations.title: 10 Riftbeast

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Krug on the Blackthorn hex. Prioritize Nidalee > Sivir items. Kogmaw provides free Shred and Sunder. Max cap is drop riftbeasts for Gnar + Ashe + Taric. Hunter emblem is incredible on Nidalee. Can also drop Malphite for Sett + Vanguard. Take tiger primal buff.

tips.tip: Play around a strong AD opener around Cinderling 2 with Riftbeasts. Slam all your AD and tank items aggressively for win streak.
Comp is very Sword hungry so keep taking them off augments / carousels when possible. You can flex in 5 Riftbeast for better shops or more generic frontline.
Level to 8 and roll for Nidalee, Sivir, and Malphite / tank. If Malphite is too contested, consider Sentinel or Krug tank instead.

comp_recommendations.title: Primal Jungle

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Morgana holds utility items. You can tank either Sentinel or Sett. Best emblem = Invoker on Ahri. Late game cap with Ashe + Alune over Karma.

tips.tip: Look for 3 Blossom early and play for win streak. Karma can hold items for Ahri. Itemize Yorick or any other 2* tank.
Flex in more Blossom or Spellweavers as you get them. You can tank all kinds of frontline: Juggernauts, Defenders, or Vanguards.
Level and roll for Ahri, Morgana, and the frontline. Once stable, go level 9 for Lux.

comp_recommendations.title: Ahri Morgana

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: +1 tier in strength with Artifact.  VI 3 is stronger than Krug 3. Item priority: Master Yi/Rengar > Tank > Nidalee. Only take Phoenix Primal buff if ahead. Otherwise, Execute / Healing Primal. Rengar and Yi have the exact same BIS. Yi is stronger but itemize whoever is upgraded first.

tips.tip: Ideally play around a Rengar opener that can win streak. Blossom is very powerful to get early econ or item wisps.
Add more Adaptors and frontline as you go. Finish Yi/Rengar items by end of stage. You can even play 5 Blossom for maximum Wisp greed if you highroll the 4 costs.
Level to 7 and roll for Master Yi 2, Rengar 2, and a Juggernaut Tank. Econ up and slow roll for 3*. Add Kog or a flex unit in at 8.

comp_recommendations.title: Yi Rengar

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Only strong with +1 Rapidfire, play another version if you have it. Don't need much attack speed with 5 rapidfire.

tips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. All ad items are good slams besides rageblade.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

comp_recommendations.title: Aphelios Rapidfire

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: More of an Azir comp than a Khazix comp, we just want executioner buff than we feed Kha to blackthorn hex for offensive Azir Stacks. If you have lots of Kha upgrades drop Sett + Reksai for Ahri + WW/Malphite for Spellweaver+Ravager. With enough mana gen from blackthorn, Azir doesn't need attack speed, but Rageblade is okay on him.

tips.tip: Try to angle this comp with early Azir ideally with blossom opener for better charms.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Make sure you have 2* Azir, Kha and Vi on 4-1, then slowroll above 50 for 3 stars. Make sure Kha has 8 takedowns before feeding to blackthorn, 3 executioner is very important.

comp_recommendations.title: Azir Reroll

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Sacrifice a high quality unit like 2* 4 cost Soraka so you can get lots of Mana + Damage Amp for your Blackthorn carries. Blackthorn Lux caps the board very high, but you can also play Alune instead.

tips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Blossom. Slam generic AP items and Malphite items for a win streak.
Add in useful 3 costs like Fiddlesticks, Cassio, Azir then flex around their traits. General rule: put items on upgraded units.
Level and roll for Malphite. You will often have to itemize and work with whoever you hit so be flexible. Once stable on Azir 2, Zyra, and Malphite, push to 9.

comp_recommendations.title: Blackthorn Malphite

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Only play with fae emblem, Can drop Soraka + Hecarim + Fiddlesticks for Aphelios + Ornn + Diana.

tips.tip: Open with upgraded Elderwood and slam items on LeBlanc or Xayah. LeBlanc can farm copies of units on your board so avoid fielding unwanted units.
Don't play 4 fae in the midgame until you have at least 4 pixie stats. Level for more elderwoods/frontline and save gold.
Level to 8 and look for Ezreal and Lillia for 4 Fae. Roll aggressively for 2 stars on level 8 because Fae can give us gold later..

comp_recommendations.title: Fae Ezreal

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Core units are Aphelios + Diana + Sentinel + Mama Beak. Red Buff is BIS Aphelios but you can also play Rageblade build. Play Scuttlecrab + Rakan over Brambleback if no melee items. Can duo carry Zyra or Morgana if extra AP items.

tips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

comp_recommendations.title: Aphelios Vanguards

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Best with Executioner emblem. Focus Ezreal + Tank items first then rest on Ahri->Soraka. Elderwood Lux caps the board.

tips.tip: Open with upgraded Elderwood and slam items on LeBlanc or Xayah. LeBlanc can farm copies of units on your board so avoid fielding unwanted units.
Add more Elderwood as you level with Spellweavers. If you start getting AD items, play them on Xayah / Rapidfires.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Ezreal and the 4 costs, only go 9 once you have upgraded most things.

comp_recommendations.title: Woodblossom

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Ahri 2 > Cassio 2 > Ahri 1 > Alune for backline item distribution, this comp doesn't have enough frontline for Alune's moon. Only play with spellweaver emblem, lategame move emblem + Cass items onto Lux or Ivern 2.

tips.tip: Look for 3 Blossom early and play for win streak. Karma can hold items for Ahri. Itemize Yorick or any other 2* tank.
Flex in more Blossom or Spellweavers as you get them. You can tank all kinds of frontline: Juggernauts, Defenders, or Vanguards.
Level and roll for Ahri, Morgana, and the frontline. Once stable, go level 9 for Lux.

comp_recommendations.title: Spellweaver Ahri

comp_recommendations.augmentsTip: Comp to play with AD items and a Fae emblem. If you hit Fae Lux with emblem you can drop Xayah and Rakan for better units.

tips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Can also play Elderwood with Ornn + Xayah + Hecarim.
Level to 8 and roll for Aphelios and Lillia. Prioritize upgrades before pushing levels to 9.

comp_recommendations.title: Afaelios
